title: 张劲学
body:
张劲学，致力于跨文化与传统宗教交流的实践者。他早年曾于泰国修学，这段经历赋予他包容的跨文化视野。
现阶段，他积极推动与美国阳翥道教协会等海外组织的深度交流。他期望透过跨宗教对话与文化体验活动，打破文化壁垒，向美国社会展现中国传统文化的当代价值。他致力于成为坚实的中美文化桥梁，让“和而不同”、“天人合一”的东方智慧在西方生根，为促进世界宗教和谐贡献力量。
body_en:
Zhang Jinxue is a practitioner dedicated to cross-cultural exchange and dialogue among traditional religions. In his early years, he pursued religious studies in Thailand, an experience that shaped his inclusive and cross-cultural perspective.

He is currently committed to fostering meaningful exchanges with overseas organizations, including the Yangzhu Taoist Association of America. Through interfaith dialogue and cultural immersion activities, he seeks to break down cultural barriers and demonstrate the contemporary relevance of traditional Chinese culture to American society.

He aspires to serve as a strong cultural bridge between China and the United States, enabling Eastern philosophical principles such as “Harmony in Diversity” and “Unity of Heaven and Humanity” to take root in the Western world, while contributing to global religious harmony.
